relationship: Original Second Wind JavaScript wrapping pinned AWS CDK L1 SageMaker resources and the published JumpStart endpoint construct. It provides JumpStart catalog-key and custom-container modes, VPC configuration, caller endpoint-config properties, model-linked variants, and endpoint outputs. No upstream implementation source is copied.

upstream_source_files.relationship: JumpStart key lookup behavior inspected; exact model catalog key names are required.
Published JumpStart model API declaration inspected.
Published endpoint construct implementation inspected for model artifact, VPC, EULA, instance validation, and linked endpoint resources.
Published endpoint construct API declaration inspected.

runtime_boundary: Native Node.js local CDK synthesis; no AWS API calls, model invocation, or deployment. Hosted private preview remains unavailable for this dependency closure.
review_status: draft; product, runtime, license, and publication review pending

license_mapping.dependency_license_source: pinned npm package metadata and included package LICENSE

supported_api.jumpstart: Pinned package catalog key, supported instance type, role, optional CDK IVpc, explicit EULA opt-in, and full CfnEndpointConfigProps; every production variant is linked to the generated model.
supported_api.custom: Named SageMaker model from ECR image and S3 artifact, execution role, optional CDK IVpc, and full CfnEndpointConfigProps; every production variant is linked to the generated model.
supported_api.serialized_preview: JSON preview supports production variants, KMS key ID, network isolation, and existing VPC subnet/security-group IDs; it does not serialize advanced CfnEndpointConfigProps.

implementation_limitations: JumpStart model_id must be an exact key in the pinned package catalog; arbitrary model IDs are not translated.
JumpStart model/Region/instance availability is constrained by the pinned catalog and construct.
Custom mode deploys a SageMaker model from a caller-provided inference image and S3 artifact; it does not resolve third-party model IDs.
The JSON preview adapter omits advanced endpoint config fields; the exported CDK builders accept the full CfnEndpointConfigProps.
Local synthesis does not verify AWS permissions, model licensing acceptance, quotas, pricing, service-side validation, model execution, or deployment.
